headline: Tesla to Add Cybertruck Production Shift Before Dismantling Line for Cybercab
summary: Tesla will add an extra production shift to complete outstanding Cybertruck orders before dismantling the line next year for a planned expansion of Cybercab production, CEO Elon Musk said.
why: Tesla is a major electric vehicle manufacturer whose production updates and strategic pivots significantly impact its operational outlook and delivery timelines.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Adding a production shift alters near-term manufacturing schedules and product line transitions for Tesla.
